summary: Tested login history feature in Agent portal Verifica Account view. Backend endpoint /api/public/agent-check-user correctly returns login_history array and total_logins count. Frontend shows Cronologia Accessi section with login count badge and scrollable list for users with logins, and 'Nessun accesso registrato' message for users without. All 6 backend tests passed. Frontend flow (access gate -> PIN 8971 -> agent login marco/agent123 -> Verifica Account -> search) works end-to-end for both scenarios.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The auth verification logic in /api/public/agent-check-user (lines 543-555) duplicates the _verify_agent_token helper defined at line 629. Consider refactoring to reuse the helper for DRY.
server.py is very large (>4700 lines). Consider splitting into route modules (auth, agent, wallet, admin, etc.) for maintainability.
The login history query limit is hardcoded to 50 (server.py:600). Consider making this configurable or pagination-based for users with many logins.

In CreateAccountPage.js, the login history items lack data-testid attributes. Adding them (e.g., data-testid='login-history-item', data-testid='login-history-empty', data-testid='login-history-badge') would improve testability.
